definition.window: Samples from 0.35 s before each PRE_ACTION_B0_WINDOW event through the event time.
definition.within_window_noise: Sample standard deviation for every channel in every window.
definition.short_window_shift: Absolute difference between channel medians in the first and last thirds of each window.
definition.warning: These short unloaded windows do not measure temperature drift, creep or long-term stability.
